author: JAVIERBP
body: Hello, My IGN is JavitheBoss. I was banned 8 months ago for kill aura by a staff member and i was to, be completely honest. But over time i've learned that hacking makes minecraft just not fun and bugs staff members and players. So i really want to be able to join avicus and continue to play with your amazing community and server! I loved nebula i wish i wasn't so dumb before. If i were able to retrace my steps i wouldn't have accepted the hack client by my friend. It's a good that 1.8 hacks dont exist so their will be way less hackers!I hope you can see the reason to unban me. Im sorry for my sins and thank you in advance. Sincerely, Javier
